scope: Retrospective conditional station inventory count comparison with existing risk specification; no production activation
selection: Train pooled-horizon candidates separately for bikes and docks. Choose the lowest August 1-14 validation MAE separately by outcome and horizon. Ties within 1e-9 prefer persistence, smaller boosting, shallower forest, then lexical candidate ID. Persist routing before refit, calibration or September metrics.
risk_model: Retain the fixed 15-leaf histogram boosting classifier and separate sigmoid calibration per outcome/horizon from the completed availability protocol.
intervals: After refit through August 14, calibrate 90 percent absolute-residual intervals by outcome/horizon on August 15-31 using the selected routing map. Do not refit after calibration.
evaluation: September is inspected development evidence; compare all candidates on identical eligible endpoint keys.

confirmation.status: pending a separate pre-outcome freeze and continuous source coverage

limitations: Targets are conditional on continued service and fresh endpoint coverage
Observed inventory includes unidentified operator and maintenance effects
Predicts inventory rather than attempted demand or optimal movements
Weather, advisories and optional lag observations remain excluded
